title: Happy Black History Month! Let’s read more plays #playreadingbookclub
transcript: Join our play reading book club. Every month, I am reading two plays, one from the Canon, so a Pulitzer Prize winner or a Tony Award winner, and one play by a new playwright. And for the month of February, I am reading Fairview by Jackie Sibblies Drury and Foxes by Dexter Flanders. Really excited to dive into both of these. You can choose to join along for both of the plays, for one of them, or for a secret third play of your choosing. Doesn't matter. The goal is just to read more plays in 2026. Really excited to dive into both of these. I've always wanted to see a production of Fairview, but for now, I will just read it. I sort of just know the ending, and that's about it. And I'm really excited for foxes. This was recommended to me by one of the workers at the Drama Bookshop, where I do purchase all of my plays. Not sponsored. I just love getting plays from there. Uh, and I'm excited to dive in. It's about a young, gay black man in London and his experience with queerness and the community. Really excited for both of these plays in February. And if you are reading a Secret Third Thing, let me know in the comments what you are reading this month. And be sure to join the discord where we're talking about all of the plays that we read this year.
